extras.real_size: car engine flywheel, 30 cm diameter with 118 tooth starter ring gear
extras.notes: Single mass flywheel: dark cast body with a bright machined clutch friction face, raised pressure plate mounting surface with six threaded holes and three dowel pins, shrink fitted starter ring gear (module 2.5, 118 teeth), crankshaft flange with eight bolt holes and a pilot bearing in the centre. Stands upright on the ring gear, clutch side toward front (-Y). Rotating part: 'rotor' (origin on the axis, axis along Y).

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
